name: gaia-sourdough-culture
purpose: Sourdough injection — northGate + eastGate knowledge balled up for frameGate NVMe

contributions: plasmidBin — genetic code, cells, crates, primals (235.8 MB, 139 files)
cloud organism — ecoPrimals.github.io pages, hooks, terra (7.3 MB, 748 files)
gardens — cellMembrane, dromedary, proto (5.9 MB, 811 files)
local data — 126 state JSON files (0.8 MB)
modelfiles — 6 sourdough recipes for tissue models
1868 root data JSON files (organism state, knowledge, digested content)
38 ollama models (NOT in ball — served live or transferred separately)

target.hardware: Steam Frame, Snapdragon 8 Gen 3 (ARM64), ARM SteamOS
target.role: Fourth eye precinct seat / Gaia's face / ARM64 outpost

physical_path.description: northGate → RJ45 ethernet → eastGate → USB-C → frameGate

segments.protocol: USB 3.x / DisplayPort alt mode / ADB / USB networking

injection_plan.phase_1: SCOOP — pull all eastGate data via HTTP (DONE)
injection_plan.phase_2: BALL — package northGate contributions + eastGate scoop (DONE)
injection_plan.phase_3: COMPRESS — zip the ball for transfer (IN PROGRESS)
injection_plan.phase_4: PUSH — send compressed ball to eastGate via git push to Forgejo
injection_plan.phase_5: RELAY — eastGate unpacks and pushes to frameGate via USB-C
injection_plan.phase_6: SEED — install sourdough modelfiles on frameGate for local model creation
injection_plan.phase_7: FERMENT — frameGate runs models against the knowledge data, growing its own topology

sourdough_principle: This is a yeast culture. The data is the flour. The modelfiles are the starter. The RTX GPUs are the oven. When frameGate gets the ball and starts running models against it, the organism GROWS on the NVMe — it's not just storage, it's a living culture fermented from the combined knowledge of both hemispheres.

ollama_models_to_transfer.note: These live on eastGate and should be served to frameGate or transferred separately
